DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug Reaction with Eosinophilia and Systemic Symptoms (DRESS) syndrome.

The sudden onset of a rash on the upper back, combined with mucositis and a new cough following a recent start to arthritis treatment, strongly suggests a severe hypersensitivity reaction. Can you confirm the specific name of the medication you recently began taking for your arthritis?
